items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Betsy Smith doesn't come around this area.

ctx.x: Now what about Betsy Smith? Did he ever play with her again?
I, I doubt seriously. Betsy Smith doesn't come around this area. I see.
Uh, what about Alan Van? Is he alive?

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: Ma Rainey or Betsy Smith. Yes, yes. They would come through.

ctx.x: Did you see many of the traveling shows with blues singers there? Not too many. Not too many. Did you ever see Ma Rain? Who is that?

Ma Rainey or Betsy Smith. Yes, yes. They would come through. Well, one of the big outlets for those people were the Ella B. Moore's Theater in Dallas. It was on Central Track. That was one of the few TOBA fields in the South. Oh, I see. Now, this is Keller Jefferson. He died real young.
